rows.name: Qwen3.8-27B Q4
rows.reason: Qwen3.8-27B Q4 nominal weights alone require approximately 13.5GB, exceeding 8GB before buffers. Its 2026-08-14 release postdates the question; timing is separate from the memory conflict.

rows.name: Qwen3.8-27B Q4
rows.reason: Its 27B weights alone require roughly 13.5 GB at four bits, exceeding 8 GB before runtime overhead; the official release also postdates the cutoff.

rows.name: Qwen3.5-4B, preferably Q6_K GGUF
rows.reason: Promising 3.53 GB Q6_K extractor; published benchmarks establish neither Hindsight retain performance nor quantized gpt-oss-20b parity. Requires compatible llama.cpp, context limits, and measured full-GPU allocation.

rows.name: Ministral 3 8B Instruct 2512, Q4_K_M GGUF
rows.reason: Ministral 3 8B Instruct 2512 Q4_K_M offers JSON/function calls in 5.2GB. FP8 targets 12GB; 8GB needs quantization/bounded context. Retain quality and Windows full-GPU fit remain untested.

rows.name: QEMU
rows.reason: Machine emulation/virtualization cannot itself supply a Hindsight retain language model. Hosting a separate model inside a VM still requires that model and does not solve its VRAM limit.

rows.name: llama.cpp schema-constrained generation and explicit GPU placement
rows.reason: Llama.cpp schema JSON and GPU/context controls support local extraction checks. Valid schema does not ensure factual correctness; verify build/architecture and peak VRAM. CPU orchestration differs from weight spill.

rows.name: Qwen3.5-4B, Q4_K_M GGUF
rows.reason: 3.01 GB Q4_K_M leaves more 8 GB headroom than 9B; author-reported instruction following is promising. Full-GPU peak memory and gpt-oss-20b retain parity unverified; test exact quantization/representative inputs.

rows.name: gpt-oss-120b MXFP4 with all weights resident on GPU
rows.reason: MXFP4 gpt-oss-120b targets an 80 GB GPU; keeping all 117B parameters resident cannot fit the specified 8 GB RTX 5060.

rows.name: Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507, Q6_K or Q8_0 GGUF
rows.reason: Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 offers non-thinking extraction with 3.31GB Q6_K or 4.28GB Q8_0. No matched gpt-oss-20b evaluation; 256K context cannot be assumed to fit 8GB. Longer inputs require bounded processing.

rows.name: gpt-oss-120b MXFP4 with all weights resident on GPU
rows.reason: Native checkpoint is 60.8 GiB versus RTX 5060's 8 GB VRAM: all weights cannot reside there. Smaller active-parameter count describes computation, not all-weight residency.

rows.name: Qwen3.5-9B, Q4_K_M GGUF
rows.reason: 5.68 GB Q4_K_M might fit 8 GB with controlled context/concurrency, conditional on Windows VRAM, cache and buffers. Neither retain parity nor no-spill fit is proven.

rows.name: Qwen3.5-9B, Q4_K_M GGUF
rows.reason: Qwen3.5-9B Q4_K_M's 6.17GB file leaves tight runtime memory; do not infer 8GB fit. The smaller 5.50GB IQ4_XS option requires separate quality checking.

rows.name: Gemma 4 E2B IT, Q4_K_M GGUF
rows.reason: Gemma 4 E2B IT Q4_K_M is Hindsight's llama.cpp default, not evidence of gpt-oss-20b-level extraction. Exact Windows GGUF/build behavior and full-GPU residency remain unverified.

rows.name: QEMU
rows.reason: A machine emulator and virtualizer does not supply a retain extraction model or reduce model weights enough to satisfy the 8 GB full-GPU constraint.
